hifi_capabilities.description: Discover what a zone supports before acting on it. Every capability reports one of three states: 'supported' (a working path exists), 'unsupported' (the provider's protocol cannot do it - never retry), or 'not_implemented' (the provider can, UHC has not wired it yet - tracked_by names the issue). Omit zone_id for every zone and every provider. States are per provider, not per device: a fixed-volume output still reports volume as supported, so check has_volume_control alongside it.

zone_id.description: A zone ID to narrow the report to (get from hifi_zones). Omit for all zones.

hifi_control.description: Control playback and volume. Common actions: play, pause, playpause, next, previous, volume_set, volume_up, volume_down. HQPlayer also supports stop, seek, and mute.

action.description: Common action: play, pause, playpause, next, previous, volume_set, volume_up, or volume_down. HQPlayer also accepts stop, seek, and mute.

value.description: For seek, the position in seconds. For volume: 0-100 for normalized providers, or decimal dB for HQPlayer; relative amounts use the provider's scale.

hifi_hqplayer_load_profile.description: Load an HQPlayer Embedded configuration (will restart HQPlayer)

profile.description: Configuration name to load (get from hifi_hqplayer_profiles)

zone_id.description: Optional direct HQPlayer zone (`hqplayer:<instance>`). Omit for the default instance.
Optional direct HQPlayer zone (`hqplayer:<instance>`). Omit for the default instance.

hifi_hqplayer_set_pipeline.description: Change an immediate HQPlayer setting on an exact instance: mode, samplerate, filter1x, filterNx, shaper/dither, junk_filter, matrix_profile, convolution, adaptive_volume, repeat, or random. Call hifi_hqplayer_status first for current values and choices. This does not persist a profile.

setting.description: Immediate setting to change; this does not persist an HQPlayer profile.

zone_id.description: Optional direct HQPlayer zone (`hqplayer:<instance>`). Omit for the default instance.

hifi_hqplayer_status.description: Get HQPlayer Embedded status and current pipeline settings

zone_id.description: Optional direct HQPlayer zone (`hqplayer:<instance>`). Omit for the default instance.

hifi_now_playing.description: Get current playback state for a zone (track, artist, album, play state, volume)

zone_id.description: The zone ID to query (get from hifi_zones)

hifi_play.description: Search and play music. Searches and plays, queues, or starts radio from the first matching result. Use action='queue' to add to queue. action='radio' and source param are Roon-only; LMS searches all providers.

action.description: What to do: "play" (default), "queue", or "radio". radio is Roon-only.

query.description: What to play (e.g., "early Michael Jackson", "Dark Side of the Moon")

source.description: Where to search: "library" (default), "tidal", or "qobuz". Roon only; LMS searches all providers.

zone_id.description: Zone ID to play on (get from hifi_zones)

hifi_search.description: Search for tracks, albums, or artists. Roon: searches Library, TIDAL, or Qobuz (use source param). LMS: searches all installed providers including streaming plugins (zone_id recommended as different players may have different sources configured).

source.description: Where to search: "library" (default), "tidal", or "qobuz". Roon only; LMS searches all providers.

zone_id.description: Zone ID for context-aware results. Recommended for LMS (different players may have different sources).

hifi_status.description: Get overall bridge status (Roon connection, HQPlayer config)

hifi_zones.description: List all available playback zones (Roon, LMS, OpenHome, UPnP, HQPlayer)
